text_block_list.text: On the way home. Maybe she'd gotten a bit too carried away, because she looked a little tired, so we decided to take a break at a nearby park.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hafuu~.
I'm a little worn out~.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Still, seeing you smile so much
made me super happy, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, let's play on the slide later, okay?
We can play until the sun goes down!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
So we can still smile a whole lot together!
Ehehehe!

We spent some time planning what to play,
and then headed over to the vending machine to grab some drinks.

When I returned with the drinks,
she was dozing off.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Mnh-mnh...
Carrot cakes... Ten of them...!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"...Fufu... ufufufufu...
...Mmm... mumble..."

She must have been having such a good dream.
I hesitated for a moment to wake her up.
choice_data_list: Carry them home on my back while letting them sleep.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Huh... S-So cold...!?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehe, ehe... Ehehehehe!
Time to dig in—!!
She screamed and leaped out of bed.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ah, huh!? What about the carrot cake!?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ehhh?! It was all a dream~?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Cakes were raining down from the sky, so I thought I'd get to eat a whole bunch of 'em!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
“Still... it was a good dream, so whatever!
Ehehe!”
After that, we rested for a little while longer before heading home in the sunset.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"Next time we go out,
let's go eat some carrot cake!"

"Promise!" Haru Urara said,
and we made a firm vow.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Mmm...?
Trai... ner...?

She almost woke up from the momentum of being hoisted onto my back,
but immediately drifted back into dreamland.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"...Ehehe... I can't... I can't eat
anymore..."
I walked slowly so as not to wake her. In the end, she didn't wake up until we reached the dorms.
